claim: Make every setup step of a session reproducible in the install path, in the layer that owns it: Perpetua-Tools (runtime and state authority) holds one idempotent script, scripts/install-openclaw-runtime.sh, with --check (default, read-only), --plan (print the exact commands) and --apply, covering node, global openclaw, the AlphaClaw fork build, the stable link and an opt-in --fresh-gateway --accept-risk that renames the old state aside and onboards fresh on loopback. orama first-run install gains step 0.9 that only calls it (macOS only, honors dry-run, OPENCLAW_RUNTIME=skip opts out) and never triggers the destructive option; the default AlphaClaw bootstrap gains a read-only, non-fatal Step 8; an alert-only launchd watcher reports drift. Verify the script by running --check on the real machine: all four steps reported OK is proof it describes the actual state.
